llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是临床随访研究，比较导航与传统全髋置换的临床结果、骨密度和聚乙烯磨损，未涉及应力遮挡或微动的有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, or contact mechanics; it is a clinical outcome study without biomechanical modeling or FEA validation.

summary_en.motivation: To compare mid-term clinical outcomes, bone density, and polyethylene wear between navigated and conventional cementless total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A prospective cohort study with 5-7 year follow-up, evaluating Harris Hip Score, periprosthetic bone density via DXA, and polyethylene wear radiographically.
summary_en.result: No significant differences were found in clinical scores, bone density changes in Gruen zones, or linear wear rates between navigated and conventional groups.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up with standardized radiographic and DXA measurements.
